name: Ensign Career Coach Design Tokens v2

brand.description: Ensign green. Primary buttons, links, active step, focus ring, icon fills.

brand_tint.description: Selected/active background for chips, current steps, active video rows.

brand_tint_soft.description: Hover background for chips and list rows before active.

accent_gold.description: Ensign gold. Reserved strictly for identity marks (logo shadow, cover). Never a UI action or badge color.

ink.description: Primary text and icons on light surfaces.

ink_muted.description: Secondary text (descriptions, timestamps, helper copy, eyebrows).

surface.description: Cards, header, sidebar, composer, message bubbles.

surface_hover.description: Hover background for plain list rows.

border.description: Default hairlines, panel dividers, card borders.

border_strong.description: Interactive control borders (buttons, inputs, disabled controls).

body.rule: Never set body text below 17px; target is 19-20px.

touch_targets.controls: 56px minimum height/target for buttons, inputs, selects in v2
touch_targets.chips_nav: 48px minimum target for navigation links and chips

rules: Gold is used ONLY as an identity mark (no gold or beige badges, callouts, or action buttons).
Font family is Montserrat across all components; monospace is prohibited in UI body.
Body text must be var(--text-body) at 19px or 20px on body, never html.
Text colors must strictly use ink or ink-muted (no hardcoded random hex).
Every interactive element must have one clear active state.
